_note: THIS WEEK IN NEW YORKERS, the editorial heartbeat on the home page. Hand edited, one edition a week. Five slots, each a link. Dates are the artist's published intent.

slots.s: The Sturgeon King's dining room, laid out like the real one. Gary at the counter, the merch on the shelves, lox on the deck.
The museum of modern MLow on the real MoMA floor plan. Over a thousand New Yorkers hung by a curator with taste, with models, posters and loops.
A marble run tower you walk up, one turn for every Marble Run tournament. Race paintings in bracket order, a bay for each champion, live drops from marblerun.fun.
One hundred and five New York film sets, rebuilt to walk. Now with a skate mode: quarters, rails and a halfpipe on the lots.
BOOTLEG lands on 13 Keystone tokens: the Canal Street knockoff of each New Yorker, appended as a state of its own.
